text:
maggie: quick sync — Acme integration kickoff. Buyer wants a 2-week POC: streaming SDK (python/go), function/tool-calls, and strict structured JSON outputs. They also asked for SAML SSO, KMS integration, and a price estimate for sustained ~500 QPS. Can SEs confirm feasibility and any enterprise blockers? :eyes:

 daniel: short answer: doable. For streaming + tool calls we can use the websocket SDK with structured output schema. Main risks: SAML SSO handshake time, on-prem KMS approvals, and reserved capacity for 500 QPS to meet latency SLOs. Need to confirm model size + avg tokens per response to size Dedicated pool.

 daniel: sample quickstart we usually share:
```bash
# websocket streaming with tool-call hints
websocket-client --url wss://api.redwood.ai/stream?model=redwood-large \n  --header "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  --onmessage 'console.log(msg)'
```

 daniel: and structured output spec example (send as json-schema):
```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"action":{"type":"string"},"payload":{"type":"object"}}}
```

 bryce: SDK notes: python & go both support streaming + tool/call wiring. We have a helper util that converts tool responses into the SDK's "tool_result" envelope. For the POC I can drop a tiny adapter so they can stub their internal tool calls. Also will provide an example of backpressure handling (batching + max inflight).

 bryce: quick snippet (py) to attach tool call handler:
```python
from redwood import StreamClient
client = StreamClient(token=os.getenv('RW_TOKEN'))

@client.on('tool_call')
def handle_tool(call):
    # call.external_service(...)
    return {"action":"search","payload":{"hits":[]}}
```

 priya: security checklist: they need SOC2 + SAML + KMS. If they want on-prem KMS, legal will require an addendum. Also need to confirm data residency for logs/metrics. For SAML we'll need metadata from their IdP (entityID, cert, ACS). Time to enable SAML in Private is ~3–5 business days once we have metadata.

 maggie: noted. Can we get a pricing ballpark for 500 QPS sustained? They asked if hosted can handle it or if we recommend Dedicated.

 daniel: hosted could handle short bursts but Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) recommended for sustained 500 QPS to guarantee latency. Rough atlas: for chat/stream workloads with median 64 tokens output, estimate ~6-8 GPU cores equivalent for steady 500 QPS; monthly committed pricing varies but a rule of thumb: 40–60k/mo before discounts depending on model. I'll get precise after we confirm model + token estimates.

 maggie: can you also include a fall-back plan if KMS or SSO approvals slip? buyer is sensitive to timelines.

 priya: fallback: 1) Use hosted with customer-managed KMS (cloud-based) — no on-prem. 2) Use temporary API keys with short TTLs for initial POC (we support ephemeral creds via STS). 3) Disable SAML for POC and use SSO later. Security OK with documented controls and audit logs.

 bryce: for ephemeral creds example (curl):
```bash
# request STS token from our token service
curl -X POST https://auth.redwood.ai/sts -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \n  -d '{"ttl":600}'
```

 maggie: perfect. Can someone draft a one-pager POC runbook (steps, required artifacts from customer, success criteria)? I'll send to Acme by EOD.

 bryce: I'll draft the runbook skeleton: onboarding steps, sample curl/ws commands, tool-call adapter, schema file, expected latency metrics, and a checklist for SSO/KMS items.

 priya: I'll add the security checklist section (SAML metadata fields, KMS auth flow, logs retention, SOC2 note).

 daniel: I'll add the capacity sizing appendix with a sample calculation template. Also include a note about automatic fallback policy — route to a lighter quantized model if Dedicated capacity spikes.

 maggie: action items:
- bryce: POC runbook draft (today) :memo:
- priya: security checklist (SAML/KMS/residency) :lock:
- daniel: capacity estimate & fallback options :chart_with_upwards_trend:
- maggie: send to buyer & schedule kickoff (try for Wed) :calendar:

 deploy-bot: Reminder: created doc "acme-poc-runbook-draft" in sales/gdrive (shared with @maggie, @bryce, @priya, @daniel) :page_facing_up: 

 maggie: thanks all. if we hit legal addendum need to flag to revops early. otherwise i'll loop in account exec and schedule technical kick. :thumbsup:
